notes: approve is required on create despite spec optionality: omitting it returns {"message":"must not be null","code":501} under every assignee shape.
Policy scope filter uses status "ACTIVE" (holidays use "ALL") in the {contains,ids,status} shape.
No lifecycle prerequisite stated in the manifest record; no archive-before-delete anchor is assigned to this operation.
Legacy-policy nullability/absence of the replacement fields remains open; validate required replacement state, do not invent it.
Last-Page response header is authoritative for pagination.
page query parameter is typed as string (maxLength 1000) in the corrected spec.
Proven replacement risk: PUT replaces the document; carry forward full policy fields (POLICY_CARRY_FIELDS in the TS tool layer) via GET-then-PUT.
PUT wants users/userGroups as {contains:"CONTAINS", ids, status:"ACTIVE"} filters; GET echoes them flat as userIds/userGroupIds.
Body must be sent FLAT; a nested body envelope is silently dropped by generated methods.
